d:
The Hyundai Bayon is here with prices starting at Rs 9.99 lakh (ex-showroom, India). It undercuts the Hyundai Creta by Rs 1 lakh and will be pitched as a direct rival to the Maruti Suzuki Victoris. Sergius Barretto gives you a quick introduction.
Hyundai Bayon price list (ex-showroom, India) -
Manual:
HX2 - Rs 9.99 lakh
HX3 - Rs 10.89 lakh
HX3+ - Rs 11.80 lakh
HX5 - Rs 12.45 lakh
HX6 - Rs 13.56 lakh
